[Section] Experiments
[source_id=56] We conduct experiments on the IWSLT18 speech translation task BIBREF1. Since IWSLT participators use different data pre-processing methods, we reproduce several competitive baselines based on the ESPnet BIBREF12 for a fair comparison.
